audit_scope: Read-only audit of TwinWorld_P0 experiments 1-110. No source/results/logs modified.

source_hash_review.note: Only some P4 experiments carry source_manifest.json with full SHA256. P0/P1/P2/P3 experiments generally lack per-experiment source SHA manifests; top-level source_hashes.txt covers only 2 scripts. SHA256 of all 110 scripts was NOT independently recomputed in this audit (read-only, no modification).

report_embedded_source_sha256.note: P4 report JSONs (e.g. p4b3c, p4g2c, p4g1b) embed 'source_sha256' maps keyed by predecessor experiment codes (P98, P99, P103, R98, S98, SELF, etc.). These were reviewed but not independently recomputed.

key_source_files.role: P0 CPU-only spring-damper coupled/independent simulator (RK1 Euler; NOT the RK4 used in P3/P4).
Frozen research protocol: promotion gates P0-P4, controls, primary metrics.

critical_note: P3/P4 experiments use their own embedded MuJoCo/RK4 physics generators with candidate laws (elastic/deadzone/cubic) and domains (wide/outer_box), NOT the P0 twincore.py. The later 'RK4' generator is a single implementation; its IDEAL and SHIFTED arms are two hypotheses of ONE engine, not two independent simulators.

reproducibility_flags.detail: This audit did not recompute SHA256 for all 110 scripts; treat per-file hash verification as a pre-submission TODO.
Many *_audit_PRIVATE.json / *_PRIVATE.csv are present but were summarized at high level; per-row private counters were not exhaustively re-derived.
E4 was not accessed anywhere; no E4 final test executed (per constraints).
